items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: We have a harpist, Goodspeed I think her name is, she lives in Ojai. She worked with Spike Jones. And she told me the oddest story.

ctx.x: Especially when you watch the live stuff — to do what they were doing and play that music.

We have a harpist, Goodspeed I think her name is, she lives in Ojai. She worked with Spike Jones. And she told me the oddest story. They were in some theater and the harp fell off the stage and hit a trampoline and it bounced up in the air and Spike came up to her and said, “Could you do that every night?”
